player_0.content: New plan: I got stuck in a loop between Solarium and Mudroom, repeatedly going east and then west. What is worse, after going back and forth for some time, I decided to keep visiting the same rooms instead of exploring other areas. Next time, I will pay more attention to the available directions in each room and try to visit rooms that I haven't been to before. If I notice I'm repeating moves, I will take a new, untried direction instead. I will also try to remember which rooms I have already visited to avoid revisiting them.
